scientific_integrity: Finite checks provide corroboration; the all-parameter conclusion follows from the stated algebraic proof. No independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes congruent to three modulo four and even stabilizer-check rank, excluding the zero-logical-qudit corner (3,2). Guarantees joint-Lee, not ordinary quantum Hamming distance; independent priority verification not performed.
title: Complex-structure perfect joint-Lee stabilizer codes over primes congruent to three modulo four
